title: OWASP Security Shepherd
description: A web and mobile security training platform from OWASP with lessons and progressively harder challenge levels, each returning a result key: injection, cross-site scripting, broken authentication and session management, insecure direct object references, CSRF and cryptographic flaws.
question: Read the flag from the flags table of the SQL Injection lesson's schema. The in-app lessons and challenges still return their own result keys.
